Additional comments:

questions.answer: BA

questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: I was very happy to have portuguese classes, the general academic level was not very high, still I leave Brazil with a very good understanding of it's history, culture and language

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: More informal in Rio

questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
- Brazilian Culture
- Portuguese classes
- Brazilian History
- Geopolitics
- From stereotypes to reality

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Brazilian culture was very interesting, we were tasked with making a documentary about Brazilian culture. I think giving students a semester project is a great way to challenge them.

questions.answer: challenging but fun. Brazil is very different from Denmark, but people are generally very friendly and inviting, which makes the process fun and interesting

questions.answer: People, samba, beaches, the love of football

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
- Brazil is a huge country, remember to visit as much of it as you can
- Join a sports club
- Try to make local friends
